lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Quasi-circular high-luminance pixel clusters organized into approximately six horizontal rows, with inter-node distance increasing along the anterior-posterior axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect horizontal spot rows, creating a Cartesian-like grid where high-luminance nodes are centered within the vertical bands.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with a light dorsal edge and a shadowed ventral edge running parallel to the longitudinal axis.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a high-density, stochastic arrangement of micro-blobs with significantly smaller pixel diameters compared to the primary lateral flank constellation.
